botAgents.wecomNotice: Inbound prefers WeCom AI Bot WebSocket long connections, so local development does not need a public callback URL. Outbound uses WeCom group bot Webhooks.
botAgents.wecomBotIdHelp: BotID from the WeCom AI Bot configuration.
botAgents.slackNotice: Inbound prefers Slack Socket Mode long connections, so local development does not need a public callback URL. Outbound prefers Incoming Webhook; without it, AOS uses Bot Token + Channel ID.
botAgents.slackAppTokenHelp: Used for Socket Mode inbound. Usually starts with xapp-. Leave blank to keep the saved value.
botAgents.slackBotTokenHelp: Used when no Incoming Webhook URL is configured. Usually starts with xoxb-.

botAgents.whatsappRelayWebhookHelp: If you have a self-hosted WhatsApp relay, AOS posts there first. Leave blank to use Cloud API.
botAgents.discordNotice: Inbound prefers Discord Gateway WebSocket, so local development does not need a public callback URL. Outbound prefers Discord Webhook; without it, AOS uses Bot Token + Channel ID.

botAgents.whatsappPhoneNumberIdHelp: Required for WhatsApp Cloud API when no relay Webhook URL is configured.
botAgents.defaultSlackChannelHelp: Required when sending with Bot Token instead of an Incoming Webhook URL.

botAgents.dingtalkRobotSigningSecretHelp: Fill this only when DingTalk group bot signing security is enabled.
botAgents.telegramNotice: Auto mode receives messages through getUpdates polling. Default Chat ID is used for test sends and proactive notifications.
botAgents.telegramDefaultChatIdHelp: When there is no inbound conversation context, test sends and proactive notifications go to this Chat ID.

advancedConfigPlatformHelp.generic_webhook: headers adds custom request headers; authHeaderName/authHeaderPrefix control the token header; messageType sets the message kind; payloadTemplate customizes outbound JSON and supports {{text}} and {{external_conversation_id}}.
advancedConfigPlatformHelp.dingtalk: apiBase overrides the API endpoint; messageType supports text/markdown; atAll, atMobiles, and atUserIds control mentions; subscriptions limits Stream subscriptions.
advancedConfigPlatformHelp.feishu: apiBase overrides Feishu OpenAPI; receiveIdType selects chat_id, open_id, or another recipient ID type.
advancedConfigPlatformHelp.lark: apiBase overrides Lark OpenAPI; receiveIdType selects chat_id, open_id, or another recipient ID type.
advancedConfigPlatformHelp.wecom: wsBase is only needed when an enterprise proxy or private network must override the official WebSocket endpoint.
advancedConfigPlatformHelp.telegram: apiBase overrides Bot API; pollTimeoutSecs and pollLimit control polling; parseMode controls outbound text formatting.
advancedConfigPlatformHelp.slack: apiBase overrides Slack API; username and iconEmoji customize Webhook message presentation.
advancedConfigPlatformHelp.discord: apiBase and gatewayUrl override Discord API/Gateway; intents configures Gateway event permissions; username sets the Webhook display name.
advancedConfigPlatformHelp.whatsapp: apiBase overrides Graph API; previewUrl controls link previews in text messages.

rd.steeringTemplateAiContent:
## General AI Code Change Rules
- Understand the requirement, related files, and risks before proposing a plan.
- Modify only code directly related to the task; avoid unrelated refactors or formatting churn.
- Present every change as a reviewable Diff and never overwrite files silently.
- Reuse the project's existing architecture, naming, error handling, i18n, and test style.
- Output must include: change summary, verification method, and remaining risks.
rd.steeringTemplateSecurityDesc: Useful globally or for backend repositories. Focuses on input validation, authorization, secrets, and safe errors.
rd.steeringTemplateSecurityContent:
## Security Guardrails
- Validate and normalize all external input, and never trust client-provided permission fields.
- Do not concatenate SQL strings; use parameterized queries or ORM bindings.
- Do not leak tokens, secrets, connection strings, or personal data in logs, errors, or frontend responses.
- Authorization must be enforced server-side; explicitly validate tenant, user, repository, and operation-level access.
- File, URL, and command-execution logic must defend against path traversal, SSRF, command injection, and unauthorized access.
rd.steeringTemplateRustDesc: For Rust backend repositories. Emphasizes Result-based errors, async boundaries, testability, and formatting.
rd.steeringTemplateRustContent:
## Rust Engineering Rules
- Avoid `unwrap`/`expect` on production paths; return structured errors with useful context.
- Do not hold blocking locks across `.await`; make expensive IO/CPU boundaries explicit.
- Handle missing fields, nulls, and type mismatches when decoding SQL, JSON, or external API responses.
- Keep public functions focused and move complex logic into testable helpers.
- Prefer `cargo fmt`, relevant `cargo check`, and focused tests before finalizing changes.
rd.steeringTemplateFrontendDesc: For WebUI repositories. Emphasizes type safety, i18n, accessibility, responsive layout, and clear state management.
rd.steeringTemplateFrontendContent:
## React/TypeScript Frontend Rules
- Keep component state clear; avoid mixing server state, form state, and temporary UI state.
- User-facing copy must use i18n, including buttons, statuses, empty states, and error messages.
- Tables, modals, drawers, uploads, and dangerous actions need clear loading, error, and confirmation states.
- Follow the existing design system and avoid jarring colors; narrow screens must remain usable.
- TypeScript types should follow the API contract; avoid `any` and fragile field guesses.
rd.steeringTemplateCommitDesc: For team repositories. Standardizes commit messages, PR descriptions, test evidence, and risk disclosure.
rd.steeringTemplateCommitContent:
## Commit and PR Rules
- Commit titles should use `type(scope): summary`, for example `fix(rd): handle empty repository scope`.
- PR descriptions must include: background, key changes, verification results, compatibility impact, risks, and rollback plan.
- Fix tasks should explain the root cause; feature tasks should explain the new capability and boundary.
- If tests were not run, explicitly state why and list suggested follow-up commands.
- Do not include temporary debug logs, secrets, personal local paths, or unrelated formatting churn in PRs.

rd.runtimeToolGovernanceOk: Tool read cadence looks normal. No obvious repetition or excessive expansion detected.
rd.runtimeToolStaleHint: No tool result has arrived for a while. The runtime process may have stopped or the task was not recovered correctly.
rd.stageTokenBillDesc: Only task-event stage details are shown here; no extra billing is incurred. The source of truth remains system token_usage.

rd.tokenRootCauseEffectFirstNote: Note: this card diagnoses root causes only. It does not limit the Agent; coding and review still read real files when needed for quality.
rd.tokenRootCauseFailedToolTip: Failed or empty tool calls were detected. Next run should narrow paths based on failure reasons instead of scanning blindly.
rd.tokenRootCauseHealthyDesc: This run has observable data and shows no complete cache miss or obvious runtime over-reading.
rd.tokenRootCauseIndexRebuild: High index rebuild share in this run
rd.tokenRootCauseIndexRebuildDesc: File changes, embedding model switches, or first-time indexing can regenerate summaries/embeddings. Repeated questions should gradually reuse them.
rd.tokenRootCauseIndexRebuildTip: If repeated identical questions still rebuild heavily, inspect whether content_hash, mtime, and git_blob_sha are stable.
rd.tokenRootCauseLargeContext: High total tokens; inspect runtime evidence
rd.tokenRootCauseLargeContextDesc: Cache has hits, but total usage is still high. Usually this needs read_file targets, tool output, and provider-side cache reads to be inspected together.
rd.tokenRootCauseLargeContextTip: Open the Runtime tab and check for repeated reads, failed retries, empty searches, and large tool outputs.
rd.tokenRootCauseLocalCacheMissDesc: Embeddings, summaries, symbol/import indexes, dependency graph, and task memory did not produce useful hits, so runtime is more likely to expand real file reads.
rd.tokenRootCauseLocalCacheMissTip: Check whether repository indexing finished, the R&D embedding model is configured, and file hash/mtime caused first-time rebuilds.
rd.tokenRootCauseNoCacheEventDesc: Loaded events contain no context_cache_usage/context_retrieval_evidence, so local cache participation cannot be determined.
rd.tokenRootCauseNoCacheEventTip: If the task has many events, wait for the diagnostic summary endpoint. If still empty, check whether the task failed before context building.
rd.tokenRootCauseNoEvents: No task events yet. Diagnostics will appear after the task starts.
rd.tokenRootCausePlannerHeavyDesc: Most tokens may be spent in the LLM Context Planner rather than the final runtime coding loop.
rd.tokenRootCausePlannerHeavyTip: Check whether context_plan_llm input includes too many candidate summaries. Preserve quality, but let the Planner see only high-value candidates.
rd.tokenRootCauseProviderCacheMissDesc: AOS local cache may have hit, but token_usage cache_read_tokens is 0. The provider cache may have missed, or the compatible API did not return cache usage.
rd.tokenRootCauseProviderCacheMissTip: Confirm whether the current model/compatible API supports and reports prompt cache usage. Local embedding hits are not the same as bill-side cache_read_tokens.
rd.tokenRootCauseRepeatedToolTip: Repeated tool inputs/targets detected. Reuse existing evidence or change search terms instead of retrying exactly the same input.
rd.tokenRootCauseRuntimeReadHeavy: Main bottleneck: runtime reads too many real files
rd.tokenRootCauseRuntimeReadHeavyDesc: Local cache participated in locating context, but later read_file/search still sent large real file contents to the model, keeping input tokens high.
rd.tokenRootCauseRuntimeReadHeavyTip: Inspect read targets in the Runtime tab first. Simple requests should start from entry points, related controllers/routes, and shared response types before widening scope.
rd.tokenRootCauseTaskMemoryMissTip: Historical task memory missed. For repeated similar requests, recall the previous diff/touched files before widening search.
